name: cache-band
description: A band above the prompt: prompt-cache countdown, cache fill, hit rate, context fill, auto-compact threshold and a Compact button. 24 languages.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band. auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale, then English.

cacheTtl.title: Cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: Prompt-cache lifetime for the countdown. auto reads CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, then promptCacheTtl, else 1h (set 5m for an API key without promptCacheTtl).

rtlInTerminal.title: Right-to-left in the terminal
rtlInTerminal.description: Draw Arabic and Hebrew right-to-left in the terminal too. Off: the terminal band is English for them, because many terminals show right-to-left script reversed. The Desktop app always lays them out right-to-left.
